name: Oscar Lobaton Salas
bio: Oscar Lobaton Salas is a technology enthusiast passionate about Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and FDE. Currently an SRE & FDE at Cobre and a DevOps Institute Ambassador, he previously served as Platform Product Lead and Corporate DevSecOps Architect at Credicorp—leading platform strategy, golden paths, agentic development, and the InnerSource initiative across 15 companies.
